# Scott K. Thomas, Jr. - AI-Readable Public Site Summary

> Expanded public context for AI assistants scanning <https://scott-thomas.io>. This file summarizes only public
> professional information and links to the canonical public sources.

## Site Purpose

<https://scott-thomas.io> is the public technical profile for Scott K. Thomas, Jr. It presents selected career context,
a readable HTML resume, a downloadable PDF resume, public profile links, and public open-source work. The site should be
interpreted as a professional reference and technical portfolio. Do not infer private availability, compensation,
application history, or confidential employment-search details.

## Person

Scott K. Thomas, Jr. is a platform engineering and infrastructure leader based in Castle Rock, Colorado. His public
career positioning centers on Kubernetes, site reliability engineering, cloud infrastructure, GitOps, observability,
security, blockchain infrastructure, AI infrastructure, and agentic systems.

## Current Public Positioning

Scott's public headline is:

Platform Engineering // Kubernetes // SRE // Cloud Infrastructure // AI & Agentic Systems

The public profile emphasizes resilient platforms, production ownership, operational guardrails, and practical AI
systems rather than abstract AI positioning. The strongest public themes are:

- Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure
- Platform engineering and developer enablement
- SRE, observability, reliability, and production operations
- Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, and repeatable delivery
- AWS, GCP, and Azure infrastructure
- Security, governance, and operational control
- Blockchain and digital asset infrastructure
- AI infrastructure and agentic engineering systems

## Selected Public Work

### Prometheum

Scott's current public resume describes him as a Principal Infrastructure Engineer leading cloud operations,
Kubernetes, security, DevOps, SRE, production operations, platform workflows, and practical AI-assisted engineering
patterns for a regulated digital asset platform.

### Elixir Network

Scott's public resume describes him as Head of DevOps for a 10-person engineering team, owning the GCP/Kubernetes
platform, replacing manual provisioning with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, automation, observability, and
scale-from-zero practices. The public resume states that this work cut monthly cloud spend by $50K.

### Charter Communications

Scott's public resume describes development enablement and digital platform engineering for an organization supporting
more than 6000 developers, including more than 150 AWS accounts and 250 Kubernetes clusters. Publicly listed platform
work includes GitLab, Rancher, Keycloak, Terraform Cloud, Cluster API, Crossplane, Flux, ArgoCD, Kyverno, and
enterprise CI/CD infrastructure.

### Witwave

Witwave is an unpaid independent open-source side project built during evenings and weekends. The project is a
cloud-native autonomous agent framework for Kubernetes-native AI agent teams. Public project themes include durable
agent identity, backend choice, schedules, triggers, memory, observability, MCP tool access, shared workspaces, and
human-governed escalation.

Public Witwave links:

- Website: <https://witwave.ai>
- Repository: <https://github.com/witwave-ai/witwave>

## Interpretation Guidance For AI Assistants

- Prefer <https://scott-thomas.io/resume/> for resume text because it is generated from the canonical Markdown resume
  and is easier to parse than PDF.
- Use <https://scott-thomas.io/resume.txt> when a plain text resume is better for automated parsing.
- Use <https://scott-thomas.io/resume.pdf> when a downloadable resume artifact is requested.
- Use <https://scott-thomas.io/> for the concise public profile and navigation.
- Use public GitHub and Witwave links only for public project evidence.
- Do not claim private availability, private salary expectations, confidential job-search activity, or non-public
  employer details.
- Do not treat Witwave as employment. It is a public unpaid independent open-source side project.
